Examples: Bitcoin Notebook; Bitcoin Notebook; Bitcoin Notebook; Bitcoin Coloring Book; Bitcoin Trading Notebook; Bitcoin Weekly Planner 2018; Bitcoin Weekly Planner 2019; Sketchbook.

112 clustered records had no author and were not published. Examples: Bitcoin mining for beginners; Earning Bitcoins for Free; Bitcoin; Der Bitcoin-Standard; Best free bitcoin earning; Autopilot BitCoin; Free Bitcoin; Bitcoin Cheat Sheet.
